resources.string: Open any creation from the catalog and tap “Get files”.
Tap Download and wait for the file to finish saving.
Once saved, tap Install — the system asks which app should open the file.
Select Minecraft from the list. The game opens and imports the content.
Minecraft shows an import progress bar. Let it finish.
In world settings, add the pack under Resource or Behavior packs.
Start the world and enjoy your new creation. Back up important worlds first.
